notes: even now is kept whole on ἤδη; reading even as a separate added intensifier remains defensible, but rule 7 gives it to the adverb it modifies and no appositive follows, so rule 105 is not in question.
The anarthrous participle ποιοῦν keeps the supplied relativizer that along with its phrasal bringeth forth, discontinuously under rule 15, and μή keeps its own not.
SBLGNT.MAT.3.10.v006 is underdetermined with r00-base compatible and the projection's δέ is translated as And, so no rule 97 question arises.
